direct.direct_claim: Z3 is derived from nematic topology alone
direct.reason: The listed homotopy groups contain Z2 and Z, not Z3. A three-fold sector cannot be read off the RP^2 topology without extra structure.

rank_three_order_parameter.requires: An explicit rank-3 tensor with a three-fold symmetric invariant. The Z3 is a property of the chosen invariant, not of RP^2.

three_coupled_nematics.requires: An S3 permutation symmetry of the three fields. Its Z3 subgroup is imposed by the coupling, so the symmetry is inserted.

three_fold_lattice.requires: A lattice with a three-fold axis. The lattice breaks continuous rotation and supplies the Z3 label; nematic topology alone does not.

verdict.extensions_status: UNVERIFIED (null for the three standard extensions)
verdict.note: The strong claim is false: RP^2 has no Z3 factor and the cos(3 phi) term is inserted. None of the three standard extensions produces Z3 without an explicit three-fold structure. A different, specified extension is not excluded, but it would have to be constructed and tested explicitly.
